name: Project board
description: The GitHub Project that tracks this repository's work (project.json names it), as a board grouped by Status, with tools for agents to list items, see what needs a decision, set Status, Priority or Area, and add issues and pull requests. GitHub is the only copy: reads and writes go through the person's own GitHub CLI (`gh api graphql`), so the app stores no token and asks Centralu for nothing (no uses, no secrets). It needs `gh` installed and logged in with the `project` scope (`gh auth refresh -s project`); when it is not, or GitHub cannot be reached, the board and the tools say so.
